title: A connect cut short by the remaining revalidation budget starts no down window for a healthy slow host
goal: provider.request under budget() shortens the timeout to the time left; a URLError timeout from that shortened connect is reported so that host_seen starts no window (the time budget shows nothing of the host). Found by the SP-u5q37ds3 review (_tools/provider.py request, host_seen).

run:
import sys, time, socket, tempfile, urllib.request, urllib.error
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import provider as P
P.DOWN_DIR = tempfile.mkdtemp()
P._down.clear()
def fake_open(self, req, data=None, timeout=None):
    if timeout is not None and timeout < P.TIMEOUT:
        time.sleep(timeout)
    raise urllib.error.URLError(socket.timeout('timed out'))
urllib.request.OpenerDirector.open = fake_open
slow, down = 'https://slow.example.com/x', 'https://down.example.com/x'
with P.down_window():
    P.gated_request(down)
    down_window_started = bool(P.host_down(down))
    with P.budget(0.6):
        P.gated_request(slow)
    slow_window = P.host_down(slow)
print('unbudgeted timeout starts a window:', down_window_started, '| budget-cut connect window:', slow_window)
sys.exit(0 if down_window_started and slow_window is None else 1)
